answers.text: The manual lists “Clear*; see Technical Data on pages 24–27” as the solution; it does not state that consulting those pages is a prescribed inspection or test.
answers.rationale: Both troubleshooting rows give clearing the restriction as the solution and refer to Technical Data, but neither describes that reference as a check or test.

answers.text: The manual says to clear the restriction and refers to Technical Data on pages 24–27; it does not prescribe checking the air supply against that data.
answers.rationale: The cited rows give “Clear*; see Technical Data,” which does not state the proposed air-supply check.

answers.text: The priming-piston cause has the solution “Clear; service.” The distributor-contact note applies only if air motor icing is experienced.
answers.rationale: The proposal joins the priming-piston troubleshooting row with a separate conditional note about air motor icing.

answers.text: The manual’s solution is to clean the dried fluid and refer to Service on pages 12–19; it does not state that referring to those pages is an inspection or test.
answers.rationale: The cited solution prescribes cleaning and points to the Service section, not a check or test as the proposed [inspection] relation claims.

answers.text: The manual says to check the wiper plate seal as the solution; it does not state that air leaking into the supply container affects that component.
answers.rationale: The row links air leaking into the supply container to checking the wiper plate seal, not to an AFFECTS relationship.
